title: Works Well but Needs a Design Revisit
text:
Works Well but Needs a Design Revisit. The best slow cooker I have used has been a Hamilton Beach Stay or Go, so I was excited to try this new one by Hamilton Beach. It has an interesting feature set and it works well, but I dislike some of the design decisions.

The listing states that this is a stainless steel crock pot, and that’s true when referring to the outer body of the cooker. The liner itself is aluminum (a detail that is not highlighted but is mentioned in the listing) and is coated in some kind of non-stick material (not sure if it’s Teflon). That’s ok, but that needs to be more clearly described. The liner is very lightweight and is easy to handle and easy to clean. Being the clumsy person that I am, it means I can’t drop it and break it like I can with a stoneware crock.

This is a 6-quart cooker, so it can handle a full pot roast or roasting bird. Unlike the Stay or Go line, the lid does not lock in place – that’s ok, if you do not need to transport the cooker anywhere. Because the lid does not lock in place for transport, it’s a simpler design and easier to clean.

It happened to arrive on a day when I needed to use the slow cooker for dinner. Instead of using my Stay or Go, I used this one instead. Dinner turned out exactly as expected and this cooker did a good job.

However, there are a couple of things about this cooker that turn me off. First, the controls are not granular enough. You can set the temperature to Low, High and Warm at the press of a button which is great, but you cannot set the time in any less than 2-hour increments, up to 10 hours. If you need to put something in for any other interval, there isn’t any way to do it. Second, the cooker has absolutely no time display so you have no indicator of how much time remains. It does change the time setting as the time counts down, so it shows what two-hour block it’s in during the cook cycle. Whether there are 2 hours or 5 minutes left, it says “2 hours”. Finally, the outer surface is definitely less insulated that any other slow cooker I have used and with no effort at all I got a first-degree burn on my hand. The liner gets hotter than a stoneware crock too and it’s easy to get a wicked burn in no time.

This isn’t a bad cooker, but there are some design decisions with which I disagree than make it a less-than-ideal choice. The controls and display need a revisit. A little better unsulation on the outer part of the cooker would be greatly appreciated. And to be honest, I would rather have seen the liner be made of uncoated stainless steel instead of coated aluminum. It does work well and it’s easy to clean which are pluses, but to me these are not enough to counter the negatives. This is a cooker I will use when I need a backup or more than one at a time – I’ll stick with the Stay or Go as my go-to slow cooker.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 33663 Programmable Slow Cooker Stovetop-Safe Sear & Cook Crock, Travel Lid Lock for Portable Transport, 6 Quart, Silver
features: LOCK IN THE FLAVOR — SEAR RIGHT ON THE STOVETOP. Sear on the stovetop, then finish the meal in the same pot. The removable nonstick aluminum pot cooks directly on gas, electric or ceramic stovetops.
15 HEATING OPTIONS. Mix and match high, low or warm heat settings with your choice of 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 hours of cooking time.

CLIP-TIGHT SEALED LID HELPS PREVENT MESSY SPILLS: Take your slow cooker to parties or on the road without worrying about messy spills. The clip-tight sealed lid locks onto the slow cooker to improve portability.

SERVES 7+ PEOPLE: This programmable slow cooker's 6 quart capacity is the perfect size for a 6 lb. chicken or 4 lb. roast. Cook a hearty meal for the whole family or serve a delicious main dish on your buffet for the holidays.
AUTOMATIC KEEP WARM. When your cooking time is up, this 6 quart slow cooker automatically shifts to warm to keep food at the perfect temperature until serving time.
description: Hamilton Beach 6-Quart stay or go stovetop sear & Cook programmable slow cooker has everything you need to create homemade, delicious meals on your schedule. Sear meat on your stovetop to lock in flavor, and then finish the meal in the slow cooker. Removable nonstick aluminum pot cooks directly on gas, electric, or ceramic stovetops and is oven safe. Clip-tight sealed lid locks onto slow cooker to help prevent messy spills during travel. Includes more programming options than a Crock-Pot Smart-Pot slow cooker so you can mix and match temperature settings with your choice of cooking times, which can be selected on the easy-clean touch pad. Choose from 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 hours of cooking time and high, low, or warm temperature settings. The 6-Quart oval pot is the perfect size for a 6 lb. Chicken or 4 lb. Roast. Both pot and lid are dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
